rows.en:
(Classes are over, so maybe I'll go have
some fun somewhere on the way home.)
Hey, isn't that...?

If you're free after this, want to go
hang out somewhere?

I'm sorry...
My parents are coming home early today...

If I'm not back at the mansion by then,
I'll get scolded.
Well, then it can't be helped.

I'm sorry, when you went to the trouble
of inviting me!

Don't worry about it.
Let's go hang out some other time!

Okay, I'll be looking forward to it.
Well then, I'll be going.

(A mansion, huh... Shirakawa really is
a proper rich young lady...)

(Classes are over, so maybe I'll go have
some fun somewhere on the way home~)
Hey, Miyukiii!
Oh, \p-san.

If you're free after this, do you want to go
hang out somewhere?
Well, I guess it can't be helped, then.

Don't worry about it.
Let's go hang out some other time, okay?

(A mansion, huh... Miyuki really is
a proper rich young lady...)
(Oh, it's Ranka!)

(Having lunch with the Performing Arts kids?
Looks like she's really fit in.)
rows.notes: Male. "geinou koosu" = the Performing Arts Course; "kids" for "ko-tachi".

rows.en: That was Ranka-san just now, wasn't it?

Oh, Shirakawa.
Looks like Ranka's gotten used to life here.

It seems so.
Ranka-san is a wonderful person, after all.

...Oh, that reminds me, the other day
I saw Ranka-san at Folmo.
Huh, really?

But for some reason...
she was wearing a carrot on her head...
Huh...? A carrot...?

Yes. And another day, she was dressed
as straw-wrapped natto...
rows.notes: Both variants, Miyuki. "wara nattou": natto sold wrapped in straw (Ranka's natto commercial costume).

rows.en: A carrot...? Natto...?

Oh! That must've been for work, I bet.
Ranka's still a rookie idol, so...
What? Idols have to dress up like that too?!

I imagined it'd be more glamorous...
It must be tough.
Yeah, I guess so.

But I hope Ranka-san gets to stand
on a big stage someday...
Yeah. She's one of us at Mihoshi, after all.

Well then, I have something to take care of
at the library, so...
(Being a rookie idol sure is tough...)
(Oh, it's Ranka-chan!)

(Having lunch with the Performing Arts kids?
I'm glad she's fit in so well~)

Yeah.
Looks like Ranka-chan's gotten used to life here.
Huh, is that so?

Oh! That must've been for work, I bet.
Ranka-chan's still a rookie idol, so...
Yeah, I suppose so.
(Being a rookie idol must be tough...)

(There are still a few days of summer break left.
What should I do with them...)
Nanase, what are you doing here?

It's hot today, so Ranka-san and I decided
to go to the pool.
Oh, really? That sounds great!

Yes! The pool is sure to be nice and cool,
and Ranka-san in a swimsuit is sure to be cute,
so it'll be just the best!
Oh, uh, yeah...

Ah!? I'm sorry...
Well, I'm meeting Ranka-san, so I'll be going.
Ah, Nanase!
(Aw, I wanted to tag along...)

(There are still a few days of summer break left.
How should I spend them...)
Hello, \p-san.
rows.notes: Nanase (female variant); also Luca in scd_com_620. Works for both.

rows.en: Oh, really? Sounds fun!
Ah, Nanase, wait!
(I wanted to tag along too...)

(Sheryl's concert is coming up soon...
I can't wait...)

\p-kun, what's up?
You look like you're having a great time...

Yeah, I was just thinking how Sheryl's
concert is coming up soon...
Aren't you going, Nanase?
Not really... It's not like I'm that big a fan...
To me, Ranka-san will always be my idol!
rows.notes: Both variants, Nanase. "eien no aidoru" = idol forever.

rows.en:
Down with Sheryl!
I'll keep cheering Ranka-san on until that day!
rows.notes: Both variants, Nanase. "datou Sheryl": until the day Ranka beats Sheryl.

rows.en: ...Um, good luck with that...
(Nanase really loves Ranka, huh...)

(Sheryl's concert is coming up soon...
I can't wait~...)

\p-san, what's up?
You look like you're having a great time...
Oh, is that so...
rows.notes: Female, answering "not that big a fan".

rows.en: ...Um, good luck with that, okay...
(Nanase really does love Ranka-chan...)

uncertain: c18552: 'wara nattou' rendered 'straw-wrapped natto' (natto sold in a straw bundle; Ranka's natto commercial costume).
